business_problem: Monthly statistical forecast misses short-term shifts; deviations found weeks late causing stockouts in one region and excess in another
ai_agent_approach: Gradient-boosted demand-sensing model with external signals + agents that detect deviations and size impact and propose production/distribution actions
data_required: Order history, open orders, shipments, inventory, capacity, customer promos, PMI, oil/feedstock price, weather
action_taken: Recommend stock transfer / production reschedule / allocation and create SAP STO or planned order after approval
human_involvement: Planner approves or edits every action; S&OP lead approves above value threshold
kpi: Forecast MAPE, detection-to-action lead time, OTIF, expedite cost

business_problem: Planners discover stockouts and slow-moving stock only after the fact
ai_agent_approach: Classification model on projected inventory (forecast vs supply) per SKU-location with 4-8 week horizon + alert agent
data_required: Inventory positions, forecast, open POs/production orders, lead times, shelf life
action_taken: Ranked risk list with recommended rebalancing / promotion of aged stock
kpi: Stockout incidents, excess & obsolete value, inventory turns

business_problem: Safety stocks set by rule of thumb; high working capital yet service gaps
ai_agent_approach: Probabilistic multi-echelon optimisation using forecast error distributions; agent proposes parameter changes
data_required: Demand history & forecast error, lead-time variability, service targets, network structure, costs
action_taken: Updates safety stock / reorder points in SAP (MRP parameters) after approval
human_involvement: Supply chain manager approves parameter changes per family
kpi: Inventory days, fill rate, working capital

business_problem: Late / at-risk shipments found via customer complaints; manual carrier chasing
ai_agent_approach: Agent monitors TMS / carrier events + ETA prediction; drafts recovery options and customer notices
data_required: TMS events, carrier tracking, orders, customer priority, weather/port data
action_taken: Rebooks carrier / reroutes / notifies customer with revised ETA
human_involvement: CSR approves customer communication and premium freight above threshold
kpi: OTIF, premium freight cost, exception handling time

business_problem: Static DC assignments and lane choices; rising freight cost per tonne
ai_agent_approach: Optimisation (MILP) of source-DC-customer assignment and mode/lane mix with agent explaining trade-offs
data_required: Shipments, freight rates, DC capacity, customer locations, service levels, hazmat constraints
action_taken: Proposes revised sourcing rules and lane plan for next quarter
kpi: Freight cost per tonne, cost-to-serve, service level

business_problem: Feedstock and supplier disruptions hit production with little warning
ai_agent_approach: Risk-scoring model on supplier performance + news/geo-risk signals; agent proposes alternate sourcing
data_required: Supplier OTIF, POs, news/geo-risk feeds, weather, commodity prices, BOMs
action_taken: Early warning + alternate supplier / safety stock pre-build recommendation
kpi: Disruption-days avoided, production loss, expedite cost

business_problem: High manual effort matching supplier invoices to POs and GRs; late-payment penalties
ai_agent_approach: Document intelligence + LLM agent for extraction, matching and exception reasoning
data_required: Invoices (PDF/EDI), POs, goods receipts, vendor master, contracts
action_taken: Auto-posts matched invoices; routes exceptions with suggested resolution
human_involvement: AP clerk resolves exceptions; approver signs payment runs
kpi: Touchless rate, cost per invoice, cycle time
